title: spergula rubra subsp. atheniensis
intro: Spergula rubra subsp. atheniensis, commonly known as red spurrey, is a subspecies of the annual plant Spergula rubra. The health benefits of Spergula rubra subsp. atheniensis include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and reduce oxidative stress.
